[SCENARIO 6] what M19 deliberately does not claim
  - STEADY STATE ONLY. No transient, no thermal time constant, no
    duty-cycle transient, so peak-during-refresh behaviour is unmodelled.
  - NO PACKAGE, NO SPREADER, NO CONVECTION. The back face is an ideal
    sink at 300 K, so every delta T printed here is a LOWER BOUND.
  - k and die thickness are DECLARED, package is absent, and the I/O
    on-die share is a guess. All three are swept, none is measured.
  - No 2 nm PDK thermal data and no measured thermal data for this
    device exist, so nothing here is validated experimentally.
  - Emissivity, interface thermal boundary resistance and substrate
    phonon ballistic effects are not modelled.
  label: geometry DECLARED and SWEPT, solver ARITHMETIC, no measurement.
  NEXT EVIDENCE GATE: a measured thermal conductivity and an on-die
  split of I/O power, then a transient model with the package.

PASS: heat is located, bounded and shown to spare retention at the
      in-fabric power level, while the per-Zone alternative does not.
LABEL: declared geometry swept, steady state only, no measurement.
NEXT EVIDENCE GATE: measured conductivity and an on-die I/O split.
